More than sixty lanterns, some taller than a bus, will be floated along the river each evening at 9 p.m. Entry is free, but tickets are required for the night cruises, which cost 18 pounds for adults and 9 pounds for children. The council has added two extra shuttle buses from the railway station, running every ten minutes until midnight. Local baker Maria Okafor says her stall will sell 3,000 lantern-shaped biscuits, and she has hired four temporary helpers.
